data.gender_notes: Kristof is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Christos', meaning 'anointed one', and 'phoros', meaning 'bearer'. The name Kristof signifies one who bears or carries Christ. The name Kristof carries the meaning “Christ-bearer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kristof usually hope their child will grow to embody christ-bearer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolic of carrying the love and teachings of Christ in one's heart and actions.
data.etymology: Kristof belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Christ-bearer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kristof total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
